issue.title: LeakSan: 80-byte leak at shutdown after atexit.register of bound list.append(-0.0)

labels.name: type-bug
labels.description: An unexpected behavior, bug, or error

issue.body:
# Bug report

### Bug description:

```python
import atexit
import unittest
class GeneralTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        atexit._clear()
    def tearDown(self):
            self.assertEqual(type(cm.unraisable.exc_value), exc_type)
    def test_bound_methods(self):
        l = []
        atexit.register(l.append, -0.0)
if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
```

comments.body:
code can be simple as

```py
import atexit
atexit.register(lambda x: None, 1)
```
@gaogaotiantian Could it be a duplicate of the issue you found with refleaks + atexit?

@picnixz I'm not sure.

@YuanchengJiang please make sure your code works (`cm` does not exist) and also give the repro steps (build options/tool/command to run). I failed to repro it on my Mac.
Closing, Tian asked for a working reproducer in October, but it still has not been provided.
